item.title: Sejong University's Platform-Media Research Institute Selected for NRF Humanities and Social Sciences Research Institute Support Project (세종대 플랫폼-미디어연구소, 한국연구재단 인문사회연구소지원사업 선정)
item.description:
Sejong University (President Eom Jong-hwa) announced that its Platform-Media Research Institute (Director: Professor Im Jong-soo, Department of Media and Communication) has been finally selected for the 2026 National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) Humanities and Social Sciences Research Institute Support Project under the 'Pure Academic Research Type - DB Construction' category. (세종대학교(총장 엄종화) 플랫폼-미디어연구소(소장 임종수 교수, 미디어커뮤니케이션학과) 2026년도 한국연구재단 인문사회연구소지원사업 ‘순수학문연구형-DB구축 유형’에 최종 선정됐다.)

With this selection, the Platform-Media Research Institute will conduct research totaling 1.56 billion KRW (excluding indirect costs) over six years, from September 1 through August 2032. (이번 선정에 따라 플랫폼-미디어연구소는 9월 1일부터 2032년 8월까지 6년간 총 15억 6천만 원(간접비 제외) 규모의 연구를 수행한다.)

The research project, titled 'Research on Building a Global OTT DB and Developing the Global OTT Influence Index (GOII),' is an interdisciplinary convergence study that combines the Department of Media and Communication with statistical physics and library and information science. (연구과제는 ‘글로벌 OTT DB 구축과 영향력 지수(GOII) 개발 연구’로, 미디어커뮤니케이션학과 통계물리학, 문헌정보학을 결합한 학제간 융합 연구다.)

The research team will build a comprehensive global OTT academic database (DB) integrating OTT content, consumption, and evaluation data. This DB, constructed for the first time in the world, will be linked to DataON, the NRF's national research data platform, and provided to the academic community. (연구팀은 OTT 콘텐츠와 소비, 평가 데이터를 종합한 글로벌 OTT 학술 데이터베이스(DB)를 구축한다. 세계 최초로 구축되는 해당 DB는 한국연구재단의 국가연구데이터플랫폼 DataON과 연계해 학계에 제공할 예정이다.)

In particular, moving beyond the conventional fragmented evaluation methods centered on viewership rankings, the team will develop the 'Global OTT Influence Index (GOII),' which can measure the global diffusion power and influence of K-content in a multidimensional manner. (특히 기존 시청 순위 중심의 단편적인 평가 방식에서 벗어나, K-콘텐츠의 글로벌 확산력과 영향력을 다차원적으로 측정할 수 있는 ‘글로벌 OTT 영향력 지수(Global OTT Influence Index·GOII)’를 개발한다.)

The GOII comprises five sub-indices: △National Content Influence Index (N-GOII) △Cultural Resonance Index (CRI) △Consumption Complexity Index (EI) △Cluster Centrality Index (CCI) △Localization Index (LCI). The research team plans to calculate each index using cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies such as Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and Large Language Models (LLM). (GOII는 △국가별 콘텐츠 영향력 지수(N-GOII) △문화 공명 지수(CRI) △소비 복잡도 지수(EI) △군집 중심성 지수(CCI) △현지화 지수(LCI) 등 5개 하위 지수로 구성된다. 연구팀은 그래프신경망(GNN)과 대규모언어모델(LLM) 등 최신 인공지능 기술을 활용해 각 지수를 산출할 계획이다.)

To this end, the research will proceed in two phases. In Phase 1 (years 1-3), the focus will be on building the global OTT DB infrastructure and establishing the influence index model. In Phase 2 (years 4-6), the team will refine the index, pursue service commercialization, and promote international dissemination. (이를 위해 연구는 두 단계로 진행된다. 1단계인 1~3년차에는 글로벌 OTT DB 인프라 구축과 영향력 지수 모형 정립에 집중하고, 2단계인 4~6년차에는 지수를 고도화하고 서비스 상용화와 국제 확산을 추진한다.)

The policy and industrial application of the research outcomes will also be expanded. Policy cooperation will be pursued with relevant organizations such as the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Korea Creative Content Agency, and the Korea Foundation for International Cultural Exchange, while international joint research will be conducted alongside overseas institutions such as the University of Nevada and the Education University of Hong Kong. (연구 성과의 정책·산업적 활용도 확대한다. 문화체육관광부, 한국콘텐츠진흥원, 한국국제문화교류진흥원 등 관련 기관과 정책 협력을 추진하고, 미국 네바다대학교와 홍콩교육대학교 등 해외 연구기관과 국제 공동연구도 병행할 예정이다.)

This project selection builds on the research outcomes of the NRF Global Humanities and Social Sciences Convergence Research project 'Complex Systems Approach to OTT Hallyu Drama Consumption,' which Director Im Jong-soo led as principal investigator for three years starting in 2022. (이번 사업 선정은 임종수 소장이 책임연구자로서 2022년부터 3년간 수행한 한국연구재단 글로벌인문사회융합연구 ‘OTT 한류 드라마 소비에 대한 복잡계적 탐구’의 연구 성과를 기반으로 이뤄졌다.)

In that prior study, conducted with a total budget of 450 million KRW, the team analyzed the consumption and diffusion patterns of Hallyu content in the OTT environment using Netflix Korea metadata and data from FlixPatrol, a global OTT content ranking aggregation site. This resulted in the publication of three (S)SCI-level papers and three KCI-indexed papers. (총 4억 5천만 원 규모로 진행된 선행 연구에서는 넷플릭스 코리아 메타데이터와 글로벌 OTT 콘텐츠 순위 집계 사이트 플릭스패트롤(FlixPatrol)의 데이터를 활용해 OTT 환경에서의 한류 콘텐츠 소비와 확산 현상을 분석했다. 이를 통해 최근 (S)SCI급 논문 3편과 KCI 등재 논문 3편을 게재하는 성과를 거뒀다.)

Director Im Jong-soo stated, "To overcome the so-called 'tragedy of the chosen'—where K-content receives selection within the OTT supply chain but fails to secure sufficient returns—negotiating power based on scientific data is essential." He added, "Through this project, we will complete the 'human geography of Hallyu' and create a global standard index that policy institutions and industries can practically utilize." (임종수 소장은 “OTT 공급망 안에서 K-콘텐츠가 선택은 받지만 충분한 실익을 얻지 못하는 이른바 ‘간택자의 비극’을 극복하기 위해서는 과학적 데이터에 기반한 협상력이 필요하다”며 “이번 사업을 통해 ‘한류의 인문지리’를 완성하고, 정책기관과 산업계가 실질적으로 활용할 수 있는 글로벌 스탠다드 지수를 만들어 가겠다”고 말했다.)

Sejong University plans to cultivate the Platform-Media Research Institute as a strategic convergence research hub at the university level, transcending individual department boundaries. To this end, the university will provide 10% of direct research costs as matching funds and establish a virtuous cycle between research and education by linking it to the establishment of the 'AI Media Department,' for which the university has applied to the Ministry of Education's 2027 Advanced Department Specialized University Support Project. (세종대는 플랫폼-미디어연구소를 개별 학과의 범위를 넘어 대학 차원의 전략적 융합 연구 거점으로 육성할 계획이다. 이를 위해 연구 직접비의 10%를 대응 자금으로 지원하고, 2027학년도 교육부 첨단학과 특성화대학 지원사업에 신청한 ‘AI미디어학과’ 설립과 연계해 연구와 교육이 선순환하는 체계를 구축할 방침이다.)

item.title: Kookmin University Partners with Qatar's GORD for Climate Talent Development and Green Industry Cooperation (국민대, 카타르 GORD와 기후인재 양성·녹색산업 협력 나선다)
item.description:
The Humanities and Social Sciences Convergence Talent Development Project (HUSS) Environmental Consortium, led by Kookmin University (President Jung Sung-ryul), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Qatar's sustainability research and development institution, the Gulf Organization for Research and Development (GORD), on September 1 (Tuesday) at Kookmin University's Main Administration Building, officially launching educational and research cooperation in global climate talent development and the green industry sector. The signing ceremony was attended by representatives from five participating universities, including Kookmin University as the host institution of the HUSS Environmental Consortium, along with Duksung Women's University, University of Ulsan, Inha University, and Chosun University. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬)가 주관하는 인문사회 융합인재양성사업(HUSS) 환경컨소시엄이 지난 9월 1일(화) 국민대 본부관에서 카타르의 지속가능성 연구개발 기관인 GORD(Gulf Organization for Research and Development)와 업무협약(MOU)을 체결하고, 글로벌 기후인재 양성과 녹색산업 분야의 교육·연구 협력을 본격화했다. 이날 협약식에는 HUSS 환경컨소시엄 주관대학인 국민대를 비롯해 덕성여자대학교, 울산대학교, 인하대학교, 조선대학교 등 5개 참여대학 관계자들이 참석했다.)

Founded by Dr. Yousef Alhorr in 2009, GORD is a semi-governmental organization responsible for the sustainability sector of Qatar National Vision 2030. It operates the Global Sustainability Assessment System (GSIS) and conducts applied research in carbon, energy efficiency, renewable energy, and water resources, along with capacity-building training for professionals and carbon neutrality advisory services. Its subsidiary, the Global Carbon Council (GCC), operates an international carbon credit program that is the first from a Global South country to fully meet the eligibility requirements of the CORSIA standards. (2009년 Dr. Yousef Alhorr가 설립한 GORD는 카타르 국가비전 2030의 지속가능성 분야를 담당하는 준정부기관으로, 글로벌지속가능성 평가시스템(GSIS) 운영을 비롯해 탄소·에너지효율·재생에너지·수자원 분야의 응용연구, 전문인력 역량강화 교육, 탄소중립 자문서비스 등을 수행하고 있다. 산하 기관인 GCC(Global Carbon Council)는 글로벌 사우스 국가 중 최초로 GORSIA 기준의 완전한 자격요건을 갖춘 국제 탄소크레딧 프로그램을 운영하고 있다.)

This agreement focuses on enabling HUSS Environmental Consortium students to broaden their understanding and practical experience of the global carbon market and climate industry, while securing global career, employment, and research opportunities based in the Middle East. (이번 협약은 HUSS 환경컨소시엄 학생들이 글로벌 탄소시장과 기후산업에 대한 이해와 실무 경험을 넓히고, 중동 지역을 기반으로 한 글로벌 진로·취업 및 연구 기회를 확보하는 데 초점을 맞췄다.)

Based on the agreement, both institutions plan to pursue ▲ expansion of educational and practical experience related to the voluntary carbon market and Article 6 of the Paris Agreement ▲ educational and research exchanges with GORD and Qatari universities ▲ connections to student research and startup projects in the climate tech sector ▲ and the establishment of career and employment networks in the Middle East. (양 기관은 협약을 바탕으로 ▲자발적 탄소시장 및 파리협정 제6조(Article 6) 관련 교육·실무 경험 확대 ▲GORD 및 카타르 대학과의 교육·연구 교류 ▲기후테크 분야 학생 연구·창업 프로젝트 연계 ▲중동 지역 진로·취업 네트워크 구축 등을 추진할 계획이다.)

In particular, internship and hands-on programs linked to GORD's subsidiary, the Global Carbon Council (GCC), are expected to allow students to directly experience the international carbon market and enhance their professional capabilities in this field. Furthermore, cooperation with GORD will be extended to Qatari universities and related institutions, broadening the scope of collaboration to include joint educational programs, research, and overseas linkages for student startups and research projects in the climate tech sector. (특히 GORD 산하 Global Carbon Council(GCC)과 연계한 인턴십과 실무 프로그램 등을 통해 학생들이 국제 탄소시장의 현장을 직접 경험하고 관련 분야의 전문 역량을 높일 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 아울러 GORD와의 협력을 카타르 대학 및 유관 기관으로 확대해 공동 교육 프로그램과 연구, 기후테크 분야 학생 창업 및 연구 프로젝트의 해외 연계 등으로 협력 범위를 넓혀갈 예정이다.)

As Qatar is fostering climate tech as a national strategic industry, this agreement is expected to expand opportunities for HUSS Environmental Consortium students to enter the Middle East region while serving as a catalyst for spreading Korea's environmental and climate education and research achievements onto the global stage. (카타르가 기후테크를 국가 차원의 전략산업으로 육성하고 있는 만큼, 이번 협약은 HUSS 환경컨소시엄 참여 학생들의 중동 지역 진출 가능성을 확대하는 동시에 국내 환경·기후 분야 교육과 연구 성과를 글로벌 무대로 확산하는 계기가 될 전망이다.)

As the host university of the HUSS Environmental Consortium, Kookmin University is promoting convergence education that transcends the boundaries of universities and disciplines under the theme of "Coexistence and Mutual Prosperity in the Era of Climate Crisis," together with Duksung Women's University, University of Ulsan, Inha University, and Chosun University. Through this, the university is committed to nurturing future-ready talent equipped with problem-solving capabilities and convergent thinking to understand environmental issues from a humanities and social sciences perspective and propose practical solutions. Meanwhile, as Kookmin University marks its 80th anniversary, it is preparing for a new leap toward the next 100 years under the vision of "A University That Sets the Standard for Higher Education." To this end, it has established its mid-to-long-term development strategy, "KMU VISION 2035: EDGE," and has designated the "Water, Energy, Environment" sector as one of eight specialized fields for intensively strengthening the university's competitiveness. (국민대는 HUSS 환경컨소시엄의 주관대학으로서 ‘기후 위기 시대의 공존과 상생’을 주제로 덕성여자대학교, 울산대학교, 인하대학교, 조선대학교와 함께 대학과 전공의 경계를 넘는 융합교육을 추진하고 있다. 이에 환경 문제를 인문사회적 관점에서 이해하고 실질적인 해결방안을 제시할 수 있는 문제해결 역량과 융합적 사고를 갖춘 미래형 인재 양성에 힘쓰고 있다. 한편, 국민대는 개교 80주년을 맞아 ‘고등교육의 표준을 제시하는 대학’이라는 비전 아래 미래 100년을 향한 새로운 도약을 준비하고 있다. 이를 위해 중장기 발전 전략인 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’를 수립하고, ‘물·에너지·환경’분야를 대학의 경쟁력을 집중적으로 강화할 8대 특성화 분야로 선정한 바 있다.)

item.title: Kookmin University Music Department Successfully Concludes Summer Music Camp with 'Dream Orchestra Eunpyeong' (국민대 음악학부, ‘꿈의 오케스트라 은평’과 함께한 여름 음악캠프 성료)
item.description:
The Department of Music at the College of Arts, Kookmin University (President Jung Seung-ryul), held the 2026 Dream Orchestra Eunpyeong Summer Camp <A Summer Melody Created Together> on Monday, August 10, at the Kookmin University Arts Hall for the members of the 'Eunpyeong' Dream Orchestra operated by the Eunpyeong Cultural Foundation. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 예술대학 음악학부가 지난 8월 10일(월) 국민대학교 예술관에서 은평문화재단이 운영하는 꿈의 오케스트라 ‘은평’ 단원들을 대상으로 2026 꿈의 오케스트라 은평 여름캠프 <함께 만드는 여름의 선율>을 진행했다.)

The camp, held under the subtitle 'A Special Day with the Kookmin University Department of Music,' was organized through collaboration between the Eunpyeong Cultural Foundation and Kookmin University, and was designed to give Dream Orchestra 'Eunpyeong' members a firsthand experience of the university's professional music education environment. The members utilized professional facilities such as the Department of Music's major practice rooms and orchestra hall for section practices and ensemble rehearsals. In particular, undergraduate music majors served as mentors, practicing alongside the members by section, while faculty special lectures and ensemble programs were also conducted, providing the members with an opportunity to experience more professional music education and further enhance their musical capabilities. (‘국민대학교 음악학부와 함께하는 특별한 하루’라는 부제로 진행된 이번 캠프는 은평문화재단과 국민대학교의 협력으로 마련됐으며, 꿈의 오케스트라 ‘은평’ 단원들이 대학의 전문적인 음악교육 환경을 직접 경험할 수 있도록 구성됐다. 단원들은 국민대학교 음악학부의 전공 연습실과 오케스트라실 등 전문 시설을 활용해 파트별 연습과 합주에 참여했다. 특히 음악학부 전공 대학생들이 멘토로 나서 단원들과 파트별 연습을 함께했으며, 교수진의 특강과 합주 프로그램도 진행돼 단원들이 보다 전문적인 음악교육을 경험하고 음악적 역량을 한층 높일 수 있는 기회를 제공했다.)

Jang Woo-yoon, CEO of the Eunpyeong Cultural Foundation, said, "The summer camp with Kookmin University was a valuable experience in which the members could immerse themselves in practice in a new environment and broaden their perspectives on music," adding, "The experience gained in the university's professional educational environment served as great inspiration for the members' musical growth, and through the subsequent improved skills concert, we were able to share those results with the local community." (은평문화재단 장우윤 대표이사는 “국민대학교와 함께한 여름캠프는 단원들이 새로운 환경에서 몰입해 연습하며 음악에 대한 시야를 넓히는 소중한 경험이었다”며 “대학의 전문적인 교육 환경에서 얻은 경험이 단원들의 음악적 성장에 좋은 자극이 됐으며, 이어진 향상음악회를 통해 그 성과를 지역사회와 함께 나눌 수 있었다”고 밝혔다.)

Kang Kyung-mo, Dean of the College of Arts at Kookmin University, said, "The College of Arts at Kookmin University believes that arts education creates greater value when it does not remain within the university but connects with the local community," and added, "Moving forward, we will continue to create opportunities for exchange and cooperation so that local youth can expand their dreams and possibilities through the arts, based on the university's expertise and educational capabilities." (강경모 국민대학교 예술대학장은 “국민대학교 예술대학은 예술교육이 대학 안에 머무르지 않고 지역사회와 연결될 때 더 큰 가치를 만들어낼 수 있다고 생각한다”며 “앞으로도 대학의 전문성과 교육 역량을 바탕으로 지역 청소년들이 예술을 통해 꿈과 가능성을 넓혀갈 수 있도록 다양한 교류와 협력의 기회를 만들어가겠다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Kookmin University, which is celebrating its 80th anniversary, is preparing for a new leap toward the next 100 years under the vision of 'A University That Sets the Standard for Higher Education' and the slogan 'Make the Rule, Break the Rule.' To this end, it has established the mid-to-long-term development strategy 'KMU VISION 2035: EDGE' and selected eight specialized fields to intensively strengthen the university's competitiveness. Among these, 'Design & Content' was selected, and various programs are being planned for mutual growth between the university and the local community based on its educational philosophy of community spirit. (한편, 개교 80주년을 맞은 국민대학교는 ‘고등교육의 표준을 제시하는 대학’이라는 비전과 ‘Make the Rule, Break the Rule’이라는 슬로건 아래 미래 100년을 향한 새로운 도약을 준비하고 있다. 이를 위해 중장기 발전전략인 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’를 수립하고, 대학의 경쟁력을 집중적으로 강화할 8대 특성화 분야를 선정했다. 이 중 하나로 ‘디자인&콘텐츠’를 선정하여, 공동체정신 교육철학을 바탕으로 대학과 지역사회가 상생할 수 있는 다양한 프로그램들을 기획하고 있다.)

item.title: Sorting 'Good' Single-Homeowners from 'Bad' Ones: Avoiding Self-Defeating Moves (‘착한 1주택자’와 ‘나쁜 1주택자’ 가르기, 자충수 안 되려면)
item.description:
<<>> Seoul is a multi-layered city. For some, it is a place of residence. One home is enough for them. For others, Seoul is a place of migration in pursuit of opportunity. With universities and jobs concentrated here, entering the city is crucial. Ownership is not a must—whether jeonse (lump-sum deposit rental) or monthly rent, once inside, one gains access to the network of opportunities. For yet others, Seoul is a place of ownership. Over the past 15 years, few assets have guaranteed returns as stable and high as Seoul's premier apartment complexes. These three demands from different strata collide in the single space of Seoul. A solution that satisfies all of them simultaneously is hard to find. This is the challenge now facing the Lee Jae-myung administration. <<> Since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, Korea's real estate problem has effectively been equated with Seoul—more precisely, with Seoul apartments. The shock that followed August's tax reform proposal was likewise concentrated in Seoul. In areas dense with ultra-high-end apartments such as Gangnam and Seocho, listings have increased and prices have fallen—a welcome signal, as it means adjustment pressure has begun to work on high-priced homes. But this change alone should not lead us to underestimate the policy's side effects. Outside Gangnam and Seocho, upward movements are being observed across Seoul generally and in some high-priced apartment areas in Gyeonggi Province. If prices in ultra-high-end areas fall somewhat while housing values fluctuate across a wider region, that is not stability but a transfer of instability. The success of the policy should be judged not by price declines in a few Gangnam apartment complexes, but by how stable prices and transaction volumes remain across Seoul and the broader capital region. A situation where instability spreads beyond ultra-high-end areas into mid- and low-priced neighborhoods is something to guard against even more. ()

When Falling Listings in Gangnam Become the Policy Challenge <<> The first thing to assess now is whether this shockwave will spread beyond Seoul to the capital region and nationwide. On this matter, my reference point is the chase-buying—'panic buying'—observed nationwide in 2020. While researching the Seoul apartment market during the Moon Jae-in administration, I used the share of purchases by buyers in their 30s and the share of gifts (transfers) in Gangnam as key indicators. Now, the movements of both indicators are unsettling. Buyers in their 30s have returned to the forefront of purchasing, and the share of gifts in Gangnam District has roughly doubled while the Seoul average has remained flat. <<> Why do these indicators matter? Because both are tied to market participants' future expectations. Under current conditions, a person in their 30s buying a Seoul apartment is a decision difficult to make without confidence in price appreciation. The same goes for gifting property. Even under regulatory pressure, if multi-homeowners believe future capital gains will grow larger, they choose to keep assets within the family rather than sell. Underlying such behavior is a distrust of supply—a prediction that sufficient housing will not be readily available in the parts of Seoul people want within the next few years. The recent disputes over Yongsan Park and Tancheon sites reinforce that belief. Both sites are public land, where the burden of coordinating interests—such as land expropriation or resident consent—is relatively small, yet feasibility remains uncertain even now. When central and local governments cannot even reach agreement on the fastest-developable land, the market learns one message: building new apartments in Seoul is difficult. <<> Even more disconcerting is the jeonse market. A year ago on this very page, I said that while Seoul jeonse prices were rising, transaction volumes were holding steady, so it was not yet a cause for concern. But since then, transaction volumes have clearly declined while the pace of jeonse price increases has actually accelerated. The premise of that earlier diagnosis is now crumbling, which worries me greatly. <<> The 2020 'Panic Buying' and Its Possible Return in Seoul <<> However, it is too early to conclude that Seoul's real estate market will again spiral into 2020-style panic buying. Several reasons exist. First is the interest rate level. The bull market then was a product of the anomalous 'near-zero interest rate' environment during the COVID period. In hindsight, the decisive factor that ended panic buying was not increased supply but the U.S. Federal Reserve's steep rate hikes beginning in March 2022. Of course, considering the accumulated overheating during the Moon administration, the price declines under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration are hard to regard as sufficient adjustment. Rather, that government propped up the market with deregulation and policy financing, reducing the depth and duration of the correction. As a result, previous surges and excessive expectations were left inadequately resolved. In particular, the Bank of Korea was cautious about further hikes after early 2023 citing domestic and external conditions, and while the Korea-U.S. rate gap widened, currency instability and rebounding housing prices simultaneously emerged as policy burdens. Perhaps the current market instability is the price of failing to adjust sufficiently then. Fortunately, the Bank of Korea under Governor Shin Hyun-song raised rates for two consecutive months, bringing the benchmark rate to 3%. That decision was a critical choice that will shape the direction of the real estate market, and I believe it was the right call. The effects may not appear immediately, but it will constrain borrowing capacity and cool excessive sentiment, contributing to market stability. <<> Second is scope. While the 2020 bull market was a nationwide phenomenon, current attention is focused on Seoul. Even Gyeonggi Province has not yet moved with the same intensity. Finally, there is price. The average sale price of a Seoul apartment, about 870 million won in 2020, has now risen to approximately 1.58 billion won (based on KB Real Estate data). Given strong lending regulations and the possibility of further rate hikes, it is difficult to lend weight to a scenario of short-term surges like before. That said, this holds only on the premise that policy does not create new confusion in the market. <<> But why does Seoul's apartment market unrest refuse to subside? And why should we worry about its spread? It is because the core of this tax reform—owner-occupancy-centered taxation—is shaking the market. Never before has the calculus diverged so sharply between actual residents and non-residents across all stages of ownership and disposal within the same single-homeowner category. The strong reactions are therefore unsurprising. In particular, as landlords withdraw jeonse units to meet residency requirements, supply shrinks and prices rise, pushing tenants toward the "might as well buy" mindset. The current situation, where instability in both the jeonse and sale markets grows simultaneously, recalls the path following the 2020 amendment to the tenancy law, when jeonse prices shot up and the shock transferred to the sales market. This is deeply concerning. <<> How Do We Distinguish 'Good' from 'Bad' Single-Homeowners? <<> Another problem is the confusion arising from the new political cleavage this distinction creates. As Professor Oh Ji-yun of Myongji University points out, the reform package attempts to use tax law to divide 'good single-homeowners' who actually reside in their homes from 'bad single-homeowners' who do not. Yet a substantial portion of the 'constituency supporting the comprehensive real estate tax' will not readily accept this. Ownership and residence do not always coincide. A non-resident single-homeowner may have become so due to a provincial posting, children's education, or caring for parents—or due to expectations of capital gains. Life circumstances change frequently, but housing is an asset with transaction costs too high to buy and sell at every turn. Pushing these people outside the coalition overnight under the frame of 'bad single-homeowners' narrows the base sustaining the reform. The reform goals of asset-value-based taxation and curbing the 'one premium home' strategy have been obscured by the crude criterion of actual residency. Given the current unstable market conditions, it is hard to be persuaded why requiring a single-homeowner to actually reside in the home should be the top priority of real estate policy at this stage. <<> The top priority of real estate policy now should not be identifying and punishing speculators, but market stability. Nor should one declare success merely because Gangnam prices fell. If housing purchase demand spills beyond Gangnam and destabilizes prices elsewhere, the market-stabilizing effect is correspondingly offset. We must endure the gap until the effects of rate hikes materialize and supply becomes a reality. To do so, rather than adding new norms and exceptions, we should first reduce the 'noise' that undermines consistency. <<> First, we must reduce the shock created by owner-occupancy-centered taxation. The segments where tax burdens swing sharply based on residence should be smoothed out, and the incentive for landlords to withdraw jeonse units should be lowered. Contradictions between policies must also be cleaned up. Suppressing the market with strong regulation on one hand while doubling the household debt growth target on the other creates market instability. Supply is years away, but expectations of looser money are reflected in housing prices the very next day. Funds outside banking-sector regulations are no exception either. Samsung Electronics launches low-interest in-house housing loans for employees without homes starting in September. Though the intensity is controlled via area and collateral requirements, a new funding channel outside DSR has indeed been opened. In a market with thin trading, even a few high-priced transactions can move market prices, and those prices can in turn stimulate expectations across the entire market. <<> Three Divergent Views of Seoul Real Estate—and Taxes <<> Beneath the heated debate over Seoul's real estate market lies a fundamental question that cannot be reduced to tax policy alone. Among the Seoul of residence, the Seoul of opportunity, and the Seoul of desire—which should take priority, and which should yield? This is decided not by tax theory but by politics and legislation. What the government must do now is clear. As the Lee Jae-myung administration has emphasized, it must widen the door into Seoul and carefully manage policy so that it does not itself create new instability until supply actually arrives. The real estate market is not like the stock market, where the government can set targets, push institutional reforms, and shift the front lines in the short term. In the end, the government must do everything it can, then endure the time it takes for effects to appear. I hope the risk signals now visible are not taken lightly, and that policy priorities and instruments are calmly re-examined. <<> Choi Han-soo, Professor at Kyungpook National University (Economics; Non-Standing Commissioner, Fair Trade Commission) (서울은 다층적 도시다. 누군가에게 이곳은 거주의 공간이다. 그래서 집 한 채면 족하다. 누군가에게 서울은 기회를 쫒는 이주의 공간이다. 대학과 일자리가 몰려있기에 입성이 중요하다. 반드시 소유가 아니어도 무방하다. 전세든 월세든, 일단 그 안에 들어가야 기회의 연결망에 접속 가능해지기 때문이다. 또 다른 누군가에게 서울은 소유의 공간이다. 지난 15년 동안 서울의 ‘대장 아파트’만큼 안정적이면서 높은 이득을 보장해준 자산은 드물었다. 이처럼 층위가 다른 세 요구가 서울이란 한 공간에서 맞부딪친다. 이 모두를 동시에 만족시키는 해법은 찾기 어렵다. 이것이 지금 이재명 정부가 마주한 난제다.)

item.title: August Consumer Price Inflation Rises 3.1%... Back to 3% Range After Two Months (8월 소비자물가 상승률 3.1%…두달 만에 다시 3%대로)
item.description:
In August, consumer prices rose 3.1% from a year earlier. While the increase in petroleum product prices slowed, mobile phone charges climbed due to the base effect from SK Telecom's telecom fee discounts in August of last year. The core inflation rate, excluding food and energy-related items, also posted its highest level in three years and three months. (8월 소비자물가가 1년 전보다 3.1% 상승했다. 석유류 가격 상승세는 둔화했지만 지난해 8월 에스케이(SK)텔레콤의 통신요금 감면의 기저효과로 휴대전화료가 올랐다. 식료품과 에너지 관련 품목을 제외한 근원물가 상승률도 3년3개월 만에 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다.)

According to the "August Consumer Price Trends" released by the National Data Agency on the 2nd, the August consumer price index rose 3.1% from a year earlier. After recording 3% range increases in May (3.1%) and June (3.2%), it had fallen to the 2% range in July (2.8%), only to rise back to the 3% range. ( 국가데이터처가 2일 발표한 ‘8월 소비자물가 동향’을 보면, 8월 소비자물가지수는 1년 전보다 3.1% 올랐다. 3%대 상승률을 보였던 5월(3.1%)·6월(3.2%) 이후 7월(2.8%) 2%대로 내려왔다가 다시 3%대로 오른 것이다.)

By category, industrial products (3.7%), electricity, gas, and water (0.4%), and services (3.7%) rose, while agricultural, livestock, and fisheries products (-2.6%) declined. Petroleum product prices rose 14.2%, a smaller increase than July's 15.5%. Mobile phone charges rose 26.7%, due to the base effect of a 21.0% decline in mobile phone charges in August of last year. At that time, SK Telecom reduced telecom fees by 50% for over 20 million subscribers for one month to stem subscriber churn following the SIM hacking incident. ( 품목별로는 공업제품(3.7%), 전기·가스·수도(0.4%), 서비스(3.7%)가 올랐고, 농축수산물(-2.6%)은 감소했다. 석유류 가격은 14.2% 오르며 7월(15.5%)보다 상승 폭이 줄었다. 휴대전화료는 26.7% 올랐다. 지난해 8월 휴대전화료가 21.0% 내린 기저효과 때문이다. 당시 에스케이(SK)텔레콤은 유심 해킹사태로 인한 가입자 이탈을 막고자 한달 동안 2천만명 이상 가입자의 통신요금을 50% 감면한 바 있다. )

The index excluding food and energy, a core inflation gauge by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) standards, rose 3.4%. This is the highest increase since May 2023 (3.8%), marking a three-year and three-month high. The fresh food index fell 6.7%, while the living necessities index, composed mainly of frequently purchased items and closely reflecting perceived inflation, rose 3.2%. ( 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 기준 근원물가 지표인 식료품 및 에너지 제외 지수는 3.4% 올랐다. 2023년 5월(3.8%) 이후 3년3개월 만에 가장 높은 상승률이다. 신선식품지수는 6.7% 하락했고, 자주 구매하는 품목 위주로 구성해 체감물가와 가까운 생활물가지수는 3.2% 올랐다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-joo kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Competition in Korea's Private Education Lowers Birth Rate by 28%" (“한국 사교육 경쟁이 출산율 28% 떨어뜨려”)
item.description:
Countries with greater concerns over educational competition tend to have lower birth rates and faster declines. In South Korea's case, it is estimated that the average number of children per woman would have been about 30 percent higher had there been no status competition driven by private education. (교육 경쟁에 대한 우려가 큰 나라일수록 출산율이 낮고 하락 속도가 빠른 것으로 나타났다. 한국의 경우 사교육을 통한 지위 경쟁 효과가 없었다면 평균 자녀 수가 30%가량 많아졌을 것으로 추정됐다.)

Minchul Yum, a professor at Virginia Commonwealth University in the U.S., presented a paper titled "Status Competition, Intensive Parenting, and South Korea's Low Fertility" at a joint conference hosted by the Bank of Korea, the Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), and the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) on the 2nd. The study showed that "status competition," which compares children's education with that of other families' children, pushes private education spending to socially excessive levels and suppresses the birth rate. The conference, themed "The Economics of Population Aging and Longevity: From Challenges to Opportunities," was held at the Bank of Korea's second-floor conference hall and ran through the 3rd. (염민철 미국 버지니아커먼웰스대 교수는 2일 한국은행·경제정책연구센터(CEPR)·경제협력개발기구(OECD) 공동 컨퍼런스에서 발표한 논문 ‘지위 경쟁, 집중 양육 그리고 한국의 저출산’에서 자녀 교육을 다른 집 자녀와 비교하는 ‘지위 경쟁’이 사교육 지출을 사회적으로 과도한 수준까지 끌어올려 출산율을 억제한다는 연구 결과를 제시했다. ‘인구 고령화와 장수의 경제학: 도전에서 기회로’를 주제로 삼은 이번 행사는 한은 2층 컨퍼런스홀에서 열려 3일까지 이어진다.)

Professor Yum said he derived per-child education investment and birth rates using a model reflecting the intensity of comparison motives, and verified this through cross-country comparisons using the "education worry indicator" from the World Values Survey (WVS), as well as empirical analyses exploiting regional and temporal variations in regulations on late-night cram school hours. (염 교수는 비교 동기의 강도를 반영한 모형으로 자녀 1인당 교육투자와 출산율을 도출하고, 세계가치관조사(WVS)의 ‘교육 걱정 지표’를 이용한 국가 간 비교, 학원 심야교습 시간 규제의 지역별·시기별 변화를 변수로 한 실증분석으로 이를 검증했다고 밝혔다.)

The analysis found that stronger status competition leads to higher private education spending and lower birth rates, with competition spilling over across households. In cross-country comparisons, South Korea, Singapore, and Chile were cited as representative cases. For South Korea, it was estimated that the average number of children would have been 28 percent higher (from 1.92 to 2.45 for women born between 1970 and 1975) had there been no status competition effect. Notably, low-income households in Korea spend a larger share of income on private education (8.4 percent in the bottom quintile vs. 5.1 percent in the top quintile). Professor Yum proposed "a policy combination of taxing high-income households' private education spending to fund child-rearing subsidies." (분석 결과, 지위 경쟁이 강할수록 사교육 지출은 늘고 출산율을 낮아지며, 경쟁은 가구 간에 파급되는 것으로 나타났다. 국가 간 비교에서는 한국, 싱가포르, 칠레가 대표 사례로 꼽혔다. 한국의 경우 지위 경쟁 효과가 없었다면 평균 자녀 수가 28%(1970∼75년생 여성 출산 기준, 1.92명→2.45명) 많았을 것으로 추정됐다. 한국은 저소득층이 소득 대비 사교육비를 더 많이 지출(1분위 8.4%, 5분위 5.1%)하는 것으로 분석된 대목도 눈에 띄었다. 염 교수는 “고소득층의 사교육 지출에 대한 과세로 재원을 마련해 출산장려금을 지급하는 정책 조합”을 제안했다.)

Fumio Hayashi, professor emeritus at the National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS) in Japan, said in a keynote speech titled "The Root Cause of Japan's Three-Decade Stagnation: Implications for Other Mature Economies" that "Japan's prolonged stagnation is largely explained by the impact of early aging on growth, and the same pressures are expected to spread to other East Asian countries." From 2020 to 2050, the pace of aging is projected to be fastest in Hong Kong, followed by South Korea, Taiwan, and China, with South Korea's rate (0.96) estimated to be more than three times that of the U.S. (0.31). (후미오 하야시 일본 정책연구대학원대학(GRIPS) 명예교수는 ‘일본의 30년 장기침체의 근본 원인: 여타 성숙경제에 대한 시사점’을 주제로 한 기조연설에서 “일본의 장기침체는 이른 고령화가 성장에 미친 영향으로 상당 부분 설명되며, 동일한 압력이 여타 동아시아 국가로 확산될 전망”이라고 밝혔다. 2020∼2050년 중 고령화 속도는 홍콩·한국·대만·중국 순으로 빠를 전망이며, 한국(0.96)은 미국(0.31)의 3배를 웃돌 것으로 추정됐다.)

In a presentation titled "Changes in Monetary Policy Conditions and Implications from Super-Aging," In Do Hwang, head of the Bank of Korea's Financial and Monetary Research Office, noted that Korea entered a super-aged society in late 2024, with the share of the population aged 65 and over exceeding 20 percent, and projected that by 2045 it would have the highest share of elderly population among OECD countries. Using an open-economy life-cycle model and cross-country panel analyses, Hwang found that aging exerts downward pressure on overall monetary conditions, including growth, inflation, and financial stability. For example, he estimated that if the fertility rate and life expectancy had remained at 1991 levels (1.71 children and 72.2 years), the equilibrium real interest rate in 2024 would have been 1.4 percentage points higher. (황인도 한은 금융통화연구실장은 ‘초고령화에 따른 통화정책 여건 변화와 시사점’을 통해 우리나라는 2024년 말 65세 이상 인구 비중이 20%를 넘어 초고령사회에 진입한 데 이어 2045년에는 경제협력개발기구 국가 중 고령 인구 비중이 가장 높을 것으로 전망했다. 황 실장은 개방경제 생애주기모형, 국가 패널 분석을 통해 고령화는 성장, 물가, 금융안정 등 통화여건 전반에 하방 압력으로 작용한다고 밝혔다. 한 예로 출산율과 기대수명이 1991년 수준(1.71명, 72.2세)으로 유지됐다면 2024년 기준 균형 실질금리는 1.4%포인트 높았을 것으로 추정됐다.)

Volker Ziemann, an economist at the OECD, said in "Spatial Inequality and Population Decline in Korea: Implications for Growth and Social Cohesion" that "Korea is the fastest-transitioning country among OECD member states, with its total population projected to fall by 10 percent (5 million people) and its working-age population by more than 35 percent by 2050." He added that while the capital region continues to absorb young people, other regions face population decline, labor shortages, and shrinking local economies. He noted that high wages draw young people to the capital region, while high housing costs and congestion there make family formation difficult, deepening low fertility in a self-reinforcing cycle, and called for redesigning the "geography of opportunity." (폴커 지만 경제협력개발기구 이코노미스트는 ‘한국의 공간 불평등과 인구 감소: 성장과 사회통합에 대한 시사점’을 통해 “한국은 경제협력개발기구 국가 중 인구 전환이 가장 빠른 국가로, 2050년까지 총인구는 10%(500만명), 생산연령인구는 35% 이상 감소할 것으로 전망했다. 또 수도권은 청년층을 계속 흡수하는 반면, 여타 지역은 인구 감소, 인력난, 지역경제 위축에 직면한 상황이라고 덧붙였다. 그는 높은 임금이 청년층을 수도권으로 끌어들이는 반면, 수도권의 높은 주거비와 혼잡은 가족 형성을 어렵게 해 저출산을 심화시키는 자기 강화적 순환구조를 형성하고 있다며 ‘기회의 지리’를 재설계할 필요가 있다고 밝혔다.)

Kwanho Shin, a professor at Korea University, decomposed the impact of aging on growth into labor input and productivity channels and examined whether buffers such as older workers' labor force participation ("silver dividend"), immigration, and automation actually work. He found that the growth constraint from aging lies less in "labor shortages" than in "total factor productivity (TFP) slowdown." He therefore emphasized that policies to extend the retirement age and expand labor force participation are necessary but not sufficient, and that technology should be designed to complement older workers, requiring an integrated approach across labor, immigration, and innovation policies. (신관호 고려대 교수는 고령화가 성장에 미치는 영향을 노동투입 경로와 생산성 경로로 분해하고, 고령층 노동참가(실버 배당), 이민, 자동화 등 완충수단이 실제로 작동하는지 점검한 결과, 고령화의 성장 제약은 ‘노동력 부족’보다 ‘총요소 생산성(TFP) 둔화’에 있다고 밝혔다. 따라서 정년 연장·노동 참가 확대 정책은 필요하나 충분하지 않으며, 고령층을 보완하는 방향으로 기술을 설계하고 노동, 이민, 혁신정책을 통합할 필요가 있다고 강조했다.)

In a video opening address delivered during an overseas trip, Bank of Korea Governor Rhee Chang-yong said, "Demographic structure is a powerful force, but, as is often said, 'demography is not destiny.' Demographic changes are a formidable challenge, but we can see what's coming and prepare in time." (해외 출장 중인 신현송 한은 총재는 영상 개회사를 통해 “인구구조는 강력한 힘이지만, 흔히 말하듯 ‘인구가 곧 운명’은 아니다”며 “인구구조 변화는 만만치 않은 도전이지만, 다가오는 것을 미리 볼 수 있고 그만큼 늦지 않게 대비할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: KOSPI falls over 2% as oil prices and interest rates surge on Middle East tensions (중동발 유가·금리 급등에…코스피 2%대 하락)
item.description:
As tensions in the Middle East escalate once again, the KOSPI is showing a decline of over 2% in early trading on the 2nd. (중동 지역의 긴장감이 재차 고조되면서 코스피가 2일 장 초반 2%대 하락세를 보이고 있다.)

As of 10:03 a.m., the KOSPI was down 2.47% from the previous day to 6667.21. It opened 3.08% lower at 6625.47 and has been holding a decline in the 2% range. (코스피는 오전 10시3분 기준 전날보다 2.47% 떨어진 6667.21을 나타내고 있다. 이날 코스피는 3.08% 내린 6625.47에 출발했다가 2%대 하락세를 유지하고 있다.)

Samsung Electronics was trading at 253,500 won, down 2.87% from the previous day, while SK Hynix was at 1,644,000 won, down 2.89%. Among listed stocks on the main bourse, 709 issues fell (170 rose), showing a broad decline, with only banking stocks such as KB Financial and Shinhan Holdings posting gains of around 1%. (삼성전자는 전날보다 2.87% 떨어진 25만3500원, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 2.89% 떨어진 164만4000원에 거래되고 있다. 유가증권시장 상장사 중 709종목이 하락(170종목 상승)하며 대다수 약세를 보이는 가운데 케이비(KB)금융·신한지주 등 은행주 정도만 1%대 상승률을 나타내고 있다.)

This is attributed to a sharp surge in international oil prices and government bond yields following military clashes between the United States and Iran. The U.S. conducted large-scale airstrikes on southern Iran on the 1st (local time), and Iran immediately retaliated by launching missiles and drones at U.S. military bases in the Middle East. As a result, international oil prices jumped about 5%. On the New York Mercantile Exchange, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude for October delivery closed at $90.22 per barrel, up 5.2% from the previous day, while Brent crude for November delivery closed at $94.65 on the ICE Futures Exchange in London, up 4.6%. (미국과 이란의 군사적 충돌로 국제유가와 국채금리가 급등한 영향으로 분석된다. 미국은 1일(현지시각) 이란 남부 지역을 대규모로 공습했고, 이란은 중동 지역 미군 기지를 향해 미사일과 드론을 발사하며 곧바로 보복했다. 그 여파로 국제유가는 5% 안팎 급등했다. 미국 뉴욕상업거래소에서 서부텍사스산원유(WTI) 10월물은 전날 대비 5.2% 오른 배럴당 90.22달러에 거래를 마쳤고, 영국 런던 ICE 선물거래소에서 브렌트유 11월물은 4.6% 오른 94.65달러에 마감했다.)

Inflation concerns have resurfaced due to rising international oil prices, compounded by fiscal burdens in major economies, leading to simultaneous increases in long-term government bond yields in countries such as the U.S., Japan, and the U.K. Han Ji-young, a researcher at Kiwoom Securities, interpreted this as "heightened negative sensitivity to macroeconomic variables such as oil prices and interest rates." (국제유가 상승으로 인플레이션 우려가 다시 커진데다, 주요국의 재정 부담 등이 맞물리며 미국·일본·영국 등 주요국의 장기 국채금리가 일제히 오른 영향도 있다. 한지영 키움증권 연구원은 “유가, 금리 등 매크로(거시경제) 변수에 대한 부정적인 민감도가 높아졌다”고 풀이했다.)

The three major U.S. stock indices also fell overnight. The tech-heavy Nasdaq dropped 1.03%, while the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.71% and 0.79%, respectively. (간밤 미국 증시의 주요 3대 지수도 하락했다. 기술주 중심의 나스닥 지수가 1.03% 떨어지고 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)500 지수와 다우존스30산업평균 지수도 각각 0.71%, 0.79% 하락했다.)

At the same time, the KOSDAQ index was down 0.90% from the previous day to 813.89. It opened 2.25% lower at 802.80 and briefly slipped below the 800 mark, but has since narrowed its decline. (같은 시각 코스닥 지수는 전날보다 0.90% 떨어진 813.89를 기록하고 있다. 이날 코스닥 지수는 2.25% 내린 802.80에 출발해 한때 800선을 이탈하기도 했지만, 하락 폭을 줄이고 있다.)

Kim Ga-yoon, Reporter gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Bogeumjari Loan Sales Plunge 25% After Fixed Rates Rise… Demand Shifts to Variable Rates (보금자리론 고정금리 오르자 판매 25% 급감…변동금리로 쏠려)
item.description:
As the Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate for two consecutive months in July and August, and fixed rates that reflect such hikes in advance have risen sharply, the popularity of Bogeumjari Loan, a long-term fixed-rate product, is also waning. (한국은행이 7·8월 두달 연속 기준금리를 올리고, 이런 기준금리 인상을 미리 반영하는 고정금리가 최근 가파르게 오르면서 장기 고정금리상품인 보금자리론 인기도 시들해지고 있다.)

According to the Korea Housing Finance Corporation (HF) on the 2nd, new sales of Bogeumjari Loan in July this year amounted to 1.6127 trillion won, down 25.4% from the previous month (2.1623 trillion won). This was the smallest figure in 13 months since June of last year (1.5714 trillion won). Bogeumjari Loan is a long-term (up to 50 years), fixed-rate, amortizing mortgage loan provided by the HF for purchasing homes valued at 600 million won or less (for couples with combined annual income of 70 million won or less). Monthly sales of Bogeumjari Loan reached 2.5675 trillion won in February, marking the largest amount since November 2023 (3.0688 trillion won), but began to decline again from March. As of the end of July, the total outstanding balance was 115.8431 trillion won. (2일 한국주택금융공사에 따르면, 올해 7월 보금자리론 신규 판매액은 1조6127억원으로, 전월(2조1623억원)보다 25.4% 급감했다. 작년 6월(1조5714억원) 이후 13개월 만에 가장 작았다. 보금자리론은 주택금융공사가 시가 6억원 이하 주택(부부 합산 연소득 7천만원 이하)을 구입할 때 공급하는 장기(최장 50년), 고정금리, 분할상환 주택담보대출이다. 보금자리론 월간 판매액은 지난 2월 2조5675억원에 달해 2023년 11월(3조688억원) 이후 최대를 기록했으나, 3월부터 다시 점차 줄었다. 7월 말 기준 총공급잔액은 115조8431억원이다.)

The recent slowdown in Bogeumjari Loan sales is analyzed to be due to its reduced interest rate appeal compared to commercial bank mortgage loans. The HF has raised Bogeumjari Loan rates five consecutive times: by 0.25 percentage points in January, 0.15 percentage points in February, 0.30 percentage points in April, 0.25 percentage points in May, and 0.30 percentage points in July this year. Accordingly, the rate for "Akkeum-e Bogeumjari Loan" has risen to an annual 4.90% (10-year maturity) to 5.20% (50-year maturity). This is higher at the lower end than the variable rates (based on new COFIX, annual 4.38–6.46%) for mortgage loans offered by the five major banks (KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, and NH Nonghyup) as of the 28th of last month. In the case of "u-Bogeumjari Loan," applied for through the HF website, the minimum applicable rate, which was 3.75% in December last year, reached 5.0% in July, marking the highest level in 14 years since July 2012 (5%). (최근 들어 보금자리론 판매가 주춤한 것은 시중은행 주택담보대출 대비 금리 매력이 줄었기 때문으로 분석된다. 주택금융공사는 보금자리론 금리를 올해 1월 0.25%포인트, 2월 0.15%포인트, 4월 0.30%포인트, 5월 0.25%포인트, 7월 0.30%포인트 등 다섯 차례 연속으로 인상했다. 이에 따라 ‘아낌e보금자리론’ 기준 금리는 연 4.90(만기 10년)∼5.20%(50년)까지 높아졌다. 이는 5대 은행(KB국민·신한·하나·우리·NH농협)의 지난달 28일 주택담보대출 변동금리(신규 코픽스 기준·연 4.38∼6.46%)보다 하단이 더 높은 수준이다. 주택금융공사 누리집을 통해 신청하는 ‘u보금자리론’의 경우 최저 적용금리가 작년 12월 3.75%였는데 7월은 5.0%에 달해 2012년 7월(5%) 이후 14년 만에 최고를 기록하기도 했다.)

As fixed rates have recently risen above variable rates by pre-reflecting expectations of higher market rates, such as the 5-year bank bond yield, demand for loans has continued to shift toward variable-rate products. According to the Bank of Korea, the proportion of fixed-rate mortgage loans at depository banks in July stood at 31.9%, the lowest level in 12 years and 5 months since February 2014 (31.8%). Bogeumjari Loan rates are determined based on the 5-year Treasury bond yield and the issuance rates of mortgage-backed securities (MBS) by the HF. (최근 고정금리 수준이 은행채 5년물 등 시중금리 상승 기대를 미리 반영해 변동금리보다 높아지면서 대출 수요가 변동금리 상품 쪽으로 쏠리는 현상이 이어지고 있다. 한국은행에 따르면 지난 7월 예금은행 고정금리 주택담보대출 비중은 31.9%로, 2014년 2월(31.8%) 이후 12년5개월 만에 최저 수준까지 떨어졌다. 보금자리론 금리는 국고채 5년물 금리와 주택금융공사 주택저당증권(MBS) 발행금리 등에 따라 결정된다.)

An official from the HF said, "The rise in interest rates has led to a decrease in loan demand. Even if Bogeumjari Loan rates are competitive, if the absolute interest rate level is high, the repayment burden increases, which can reduce demand itself." (주택금융공사 쪽은 “금리 상승에 따라 대출 수요가 일부 감소한 것이다. 보금자리론 금리 경쟁력이 있어도 절대적인 금리 수준이 높으면 상환 부담이 커져 수요 자체가 줄 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Kye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government agencies join… Homeplus says approval rate for public-interest claim installment repayment rises to 64.4% (정부기관도 합류…홈플러스 “공익채권 분할 상환 동의율 64.4%로 상승”)
item.description:
With government agencies joining the procedure for Homeplus's installment repayment of public-interest claims, the approval rate for the rehabilitation plan among public-interest claimants rose 5.4 percentage points in a single day to reach 64.4%. (홈플러스 공익채권 분할 상환 동의 절차에 정부기관들도 참여하면서 공익채권자의 회생계획안 동의율이 하루 만에 5.4%포인트 올라 64.4%를 기록했다.)

Homeplus announced on the 2nd that "as of the 1st, the approval rate among public-interest claimants rose to 64.4% (including 66.2% for goods payments and 88% for employees)." As of the 31st of last month, the approval rate among public-interest claimants was 59%. Homeplus explained that the participation of government agencies and others drove the increase in the approval rate. (홈플러스는 “지난 1일 기준 공익채권자 동의율이 64.4%(물품대금 66.2%, 임직원 88% 포함)로 상승했다”고 2일 밝혔다. 지난달 31일 기준 공익채권자 동의율은 59%였다. 홈플러스는 정부기관 등의 참여가 동의율 상승을 이끌었다고 설명했다.)

Public-interest claims refer to debts that a company must repay on a priority basis as they arise, regardless of the rehabilitation process. This includes wages and retirement allowances, trade payments incurred after the commencement of rehabilitation proceedings, and certain taxes such as withheld taxes and value-added tax whose payment deadlines have not yet arrived as of the commencement date. The government agencies that agreed to the installment repayment of public-interest claims were not disclosed, but given the size of the increase in the approval rate, it is presumed that agencies holding large claims participated. Public-interest claims take precedence over rehabilitation claims in repayment, and although they do not carry voting rights at the creditors' meeting, the higher the approval rate for installment repayment, the more likely the court is to assess the feasibility of the rehabilitation plan favorably. (공익채권은 회생절차와 상관없이 회사가 그때그때 우선 갚아야 하는 채권을 말한다. 임금·퇴직금, 회생절차 개시 이후 발생한 상거래대금, 회생절차 개시일 기준 납부기한이 오지 않은 원천징수세·부가가치세 등 특정 조세가 여기에 해당한다. 공익채권 분할 상환에 동의한 정부기관들은 공개되지 않았으나, 동의율 상승 폭을 보면 채권 규모가 큰 기관이 참여한 것으로 추정된다. 공익채권은 회생채권에 우선해 갚아야 하는 채권으로 관계인집회 의결권은 없지만, 규모가 큰 만큼 분할상환 동의율이 높을수록 법원이 회생계획안의 수행가능성을 높게 평가할 공산이 크다.)

A Homeplus official said, "If we add the additional approvals secured before today's creditors' meeting, the final approval rate is expected to be higher than this," adding, "If we fail to obtain sufficient approval for confirmation by today, the damage to creditors could grow." (홈플러스 관계자는 “오늘 관계인 집회 전까지 추가로 동의가 이뤄지는 부분을 더하면 최종 동의율은 이보다 더 높아질 것으로 예상된다”며 “오늘까지 인가를 위한 충분한 동의를 얻지 못하면 채권자들의 피해가 커질 수 있다”고 말했다.)

At the creditors' meeting scheduled for 3 p.m. today, interested parties including secured creditors, creditors, and shareholders will gather to vote on the rehabilitation plan. Under the Debtor Rehabilitation Act, approval requires at least 75% of rehabilitation secured creditors, at least 66.7% of rehabilitation creditors, and at least 50% of shareholders to consent. According to legal experts, if the plan passes at the creditors' meeting by meeting these group-specific approval requirements, the likelihood of the court confirming the rehabilitation plan is very high, and the possibility of rejection after passage is slim. (이날 오후 3시 열리는 관계인집회에서는 담보권자와 채권자, 주주 등 이해관계인들이 한자리에 모여 회생계획안에 대한 찬반을 표결한다. 채무자회생법상 가결을 위해서는 회생담보권자의 75% 이상, 회생채권자의 66.7% 이상, 주주 50% 이상의 동의를 각각 얻어야 한다. 법조계 설명을 들어보면, 관계인집회에서 이들 조(그룹)별 동의 요건을 충족해 가결될 경우 법원이 회생계획안을 인가할 가능성은 매우 크며, 가결 후 불인가로 이어질 가능성은 희박하다.)

item.title: Bank Non-Performing Loans Reach 18.9 Trillion Won... Highest in 8 Years (은행 부실채권 18.9조…8년 만에 최대)
item.description:
As of the end of June this year, domestic banks' non-performing loans (NPLs) totaled 189 trillion won, marking the highest level in eight years. The increase was largely driven by a 1.2 trillion won rise in new non-performing loans from small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) compared to the previous quarter. (올해 6월 말 국내 은행의 부실채권 규모가 18조9천억원을 기록하면서 8년 만에 가장 많은 수준을 나타냈다. 중소기업 신규 부실채권이 전분기보다 1조2천억원 증가한 영향이 컸다.)

According to the 'Status of Domestic Banks' Non-Performing Loans as of End-June 2026' released by the Financial Supervisory Service on the 2nd, domestic banks' NPLs increased by 1.2 trillion won from the end of March to 18.9 trillion won. This was the highest level in eight years since June 2018 (19.4 trillion won). (금융감독원이 2일 발표한 ‘2026년 6월 말 국내 은행의 부실채권 현황’을 보면, 국내 은행의 부실채권 규모는 지난 3월 말에 견줘 1조2천억원 증가한 18조9천억원으로 집계됐다. 2018년 6월(19조4천억원) 이후 8년 만에 가장 많았다.)

Non-performing loans refer to loans (credit) that banks deem difficult to recover in terms of principal and interest under normal conditions. Banks write off or sell newly occurred NPLs, or recover them through measures such as disposing of collateral. The NPL balance represents the amount remaining after such cleanup efforts. (부실채권은 은행이 원리금을 정상적으로 회수하기 어렵다고 판단한 여신(대출)을 말한다. 은행은 새로 발생한 부실채권을 상각하거나 매각하고, 담보 처분 등을 통해 회수하기도 한다. 부실채권 규모는 이런 정리를 거친 뒤에도 은행이 보유하고 있는 부실채권의 잔액이다.)

This increase in NPLs was led by corporate loans. Corporate loan NPLs stood at 15.2 trillion won, up 1 trillion won from the previous quarter, accounting for most of the total increase in NPLs. The corporate loan NPL balance was also the largest since March 2019, a record high in seven years and three months. Household loan NPLs increased by 100 billion won to 3.4 trillion won, while credit card receivables remained unchanged from the previous quarter at 300 billion won. (이번 부실채권 증가세는 기업여신이 주도했다. 기업여신 부실채권은 15조2천억원으로 전분기보다 1조원 늘어나며 전체 부실채권 증가분의 대부분을 차지했다. 기업여신 부실채권 규모 역시 2019년 3월 이후 7년3개월 만에 최대 규모다. 가계여신 부실채권은 1천억원 늘어난 3조4천억원, 신용카드 채권은 전분기와 같은 3천억원으로 집계됐다.)

The rise in the NPL balance was mainly driven by an increase in new NPLs from SMEs. In the second quarter, newly occurred NPLs totaled 7.2 trillion won, up 1.7 trillion won from the previous quarter. Of this, new SME NPLs amounted to 4.5 trillion won, up 1.2 trillion won from the previous quarter, accounting for 70.6% of the total increase in new NPLs. New NPLs from large corporations increased by 400 billion won from the previous quarter to 1.2 trillion won, while household loans saw a 100 billion won increase to 1.4 trillion won. (부실채권 잔액 증가에는 중소기업의 신규 부실채권 증가가 주로 영향을 미쳤다. 2분기 새로 발생한 전체 부실채권은 7조2천억원으로 전분기보다 1조7천억원 증가했는데, 이 가운데 중소기업 신규 부실채권은 4조5천억원으로 전분기보다 1조2천억원 늘어 전체 신규 부실채권 증가분의 70.6%를 차지했다. 대기업 신규 부실채권은 전분기보다 4천억원 늘어난 1조2천억원, 가계여신은 1천억원 증가한 1조4천억원이었다.)

The NPL ratio of domestic banks stood at 0.63%, up 0.03 percentage points from the end of March (0.60%). The corporate loan NPL ratio rose 0.03 percentage points from the previous quarter to 0.77%. The household loan NPL ratio increased 0.01 percentage points to 0.33%. (국내 은행의 부실채권비율은 0.63%로 지난 3월 말(0.60%)보다 0.03%포인트 올랐다. 기업여신 부실채권비율은 0.77%로 전분기보다 0.03%포인트 상승했다. 가계여신 부실채권비율은 0.01%포인트 상승한 0.33%로 나타났다.)

item.title: Anthropic Unveils Top-Tier Models Mythos 5.1 and Fable 5.1 (앤트로픽, 최상위급 모델 미토스5.1·페이블5.1 공개)
item.description:
Anthropic has released new versions of its top-tier artificial intelligence models, "Claude Fable" and "Claude Mythos," which offer enhanced performance at lower costs. (앤트로픽이 성능을 높이고 비용은 낮춘 자사 최상위급 인공지능 모델 ‘클로드 페이블’과 ‘클로드 미토스’의 새 버전을 내놨다.)

Anthropic unveiled the Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 models on its blog on the 1st (local time). The Mythos model is Anthropic's flagship model, provided on a limited basis to verified experts and institutions in the fields of cybersecurity and life sciences. Fable is the same model as Mythos but with stronger safety measures, offered to general users. When the "Mythos Preview" was released last April and demonstrated high-level capabilities in detecting software vulnerabilities, cybersecurity concerns were raised worldwide. (앤트로픽은 1일(현지시각) 자사 블로그에 페이블 5.1과 미토스 5.1 모델을 공개했다. 미토스 모델은 앤트로픽 최상위 모델로, 사이버보안 및 생명과학 분야의 검증된 전문가·기관 등에 제한적으로 제공하는 모델이다. 페이블은 미토스와 같은 모델이나 더 강한 안전장치를 적용해 일반 이용자에게 제공하는 모델이다. 지난 4월 공개된 ‘미토스 프리뷰’가 소프트웨어의 취약점을 높은 수준으로 탐지하는 성능을 보이자,  전세계적으로 사이버 보안 우려가 제기되기도 했다.)

Anthropic emphasized that the Fable 5.1 model improves both performance and cost efficiency simultaneously. The company stated that benchmarks (performance indicators) related to coding, knowledge work, and scientific research improved compared to its predecessor. In terms of token costs, the company explained that standard task costs are 25% cheaper, and for high-complexity tasks, costs can be reduced by up to 45%. As of that day, the Fable 5.1 model scored 66 points on the "Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index" (AAII) calculated by the AI evaluation organization Artificial Analysis, the highest score recorded. The rival company OpenAI's top-tier model, GPT-5.6 Sol, scored 61 points. (앤트로픽은 페이블 5.1 모델에서 성능과 비용 효율을 동시에 높인 점을 강조했다. 코딩과 지식 업무, 과학 연구 관련 벤치마크(성능지표)가 전작보다 개선됐다고 회사는 설명했다. 토큰 비용 측면에서도 일반 작업 비용은 25% 저렴해졌고, 난도 높은 작업에선 최대 45%까지 비용을 줄일 수 있다고 설명했다. 페이블 5.1모델은 이날 기준 인공지능 모델 평가기관 아티피셜 애널리시스가 산출하는 ‘인공지능 지능지수’(AAII)에서 66점을 기록해 가장 높은 점수를 받았다. 경쟁사인 오픈에이아이(AI)의 최상위급 모델 지피티-5.6솔 모델은 61점을 기록했다.)

Anthropic stated that the Mythos 5.1 model improves performance in scientific research fields, including protein design and faster processing speeds for biology research programs. Anthropic plans to collaborate with the U.S. government in the future to expand the use of Mythos 5.1 in the life sciences sector. (앤트로픽은 미토스 5.1 모델이 단백질 설계와 생물학 연구용 프로그램 처리 속도 개선 등 과학 연구 분야 성능을 높였다고 밝혔다. 앤트로픽은 향후 미국 정부와 협력해 미토스 5.1의 생명과학 분야 이용 대상을 확대할 계획이다.)

item.title: Deputy Prime Minister Nominee Lee Hyeong-il: “We Will Keep the Difference Between Non-Resident and Resident Comprehensive Real Estate Tax Deductions” (이형일 부총리 후보자 “비거주-거주 종부세 공제 차이는 둘 것”)
item.description:
Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance nominee Lee Hyeong-il said on the 2nd, regarding the decision to ease the basic deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-home owners compared to the original plan, that “we reflected market opinions that the disparity between actual residents and non-residents was ‘excessive’ and eased the gap, but we will keep the difference.” He made clear his position to narrow the gap in basic deductions between residents and non-residents from the government’s initial plan of 500 million won to 200 million won, while still upholding the principle of differentiation itself. <<> At a press briefing held at the Government Complex Sejong on the 2nd, Lee said, “There were more concerns than benefits from lowering (the basic deduction for non-residents) compared to the current level, so we decided to maintain it,” but added, “The direction of shifting from holding deductions to residency deductions will remain unchanged (despite calls to withdraw it). Please understand this as part of the goal of establishing a resident-centered housing market.” This drew a line against the ruling Democratic Party of Korea’s demand to “eliminate the disparity between residents and non-residents.” The previous day, the government decided to keep the basic deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-home owners at the current 1.2 billion won based on publicly announced prices. It had initially sought to lower it to 900 million won to increase the burden, but reversed its stance amid worsening public opinion. The plan to expand the deduction for residents from 1.2 billion won to 1.4 billion won remains intact. <<> Lee said he would focus his policy efforts on boosting the potential growth rate, reducing polarization, and stabilizing people’s livelihoods. In particular, he emphasized efforts toward “price stability,” saying, “Price stability is the foundation of the people’s livelihood economy and the starting point for resolving polarization.” He added, “High prices hit the vulnerable even harder. I will do my utmost to stabilize prices, keeping in mind that the grocery basket in daily life is the report card of the economic team.” At the previous day’s Cabinet meeting, President Lee Jae-myung joked to Lee, “If you fail to control prices during Chuseok, your nomination could be revoked.” <<> When asked whether an expansionary fiscal stance would be difficult to sustain given price levels, he said, “In fiscal policy, I believe it is necessary to expand growth capacity through an expansionary policy stance and make focused investments to address polarization.” He continued, “In that process, the monetary authorities will appropriately manage aggregate demand, and at this point, I believe prices can be managed through preemptive responses in monetary policy. The price authorities will also continue to make additional efforts.” <<> Regarding the housing market, he said, “It’s hard to predict house prices, but historically, when market interest rates rise, the real estate market has struggled,” while emphasizing supply efforts: “Our measure is to increase supply so that those with a basic desire to own a home can find one more easily, and if we can increase supply, there’s no reason to refuse either tax or financial measures.” <<> He also signaled the revival of the “Green Room Meeting” after taking office as deputy prime minister. Lee said, “Once I take office, I will establish an economic issues consultative meeting so that, on core issues where inter-ministerial differences are sharp and the impact is significant, relevant ministers and the presidential office can meet frequently in small groups on an issue-by-issue basis to coordinate opinions more closely.” The Green Room Meeting refers to meetings that began in the 1960s when economic ministry ministers discussed pending issues in private. <<> Park Su-ji Reporter suji@hani.co.kr Kim Yun-ju Reporter kyj@hani.co.kr (이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관 후보자는 2일 비거주 1주택자의 종합부동산세 기본공제액을 당초 계획보다 완화한 것과 관련해 “실거주와 비거주 차등이 ‘과하다’는 시장 의견을 반영해 차등을 완화했지만, 차이는 둘 것”이라고 밝혔다. 실거주와 비거주의 기본공제 격차를 당초 정부안인 5억원에서 2억원으로 줄이지만, 차등 원칙 자체는 지켜나가겠다는 입장을 명확히 한 것이다.)

item.title: 'Kakao Membership' could launch as early as October... Bundling taxis, music, and shopping together (‘카카오 멤버십’ 이르면 10월 출시…택시·음악·쇼핑 다 묶는다)
item.description:
Kakao is set to unveil 'Kakao Membership' (tentative name) as early as next month. Based on KakaoTalk, which has 49 million monthly active users (MAU) in Korea, the company appears to be building an integrated membership ecosystem that ties together its major affiliates and external partner services. (카카오가 이르면 다음 달 ‘카카오 멤버십’(가칭)을 선보인다. 국내 월간활성이용자수(MAU) 기준 4900만명이 이용하는 카카오톡을 기반으로 주요 계열사와 외부 파트너 서비스를 하나로 묶는 통합 멤버십 생태계를 구축할 것으로 보인다.)

According to industry explanations on Tuesday, Kakao is preparing to launch a beta version of Kakao Membership that links services from its major affiliates, centered on its new entity, Kakao AI. A Kakao official said, "It is true that we are preparing a membership service that connects various Kakao services and benefits, but the specific launch date and participating services have not yet been decided." (2일 업계 설명을 들어보면 카카오는 신설법인 카카오AI를 중심으로 주요 계열사 서비스를 연계한 카카오 멤버십 베타 버전 출시를 준비 중이다. 카카오 쪽은 “카카오의 다양한 서비스와 혜택을 연계한 멤버십 서비스를 준비 중인 것은 맞지만, 구체적인 출시 시점과 참여 서비스 등은 아직 정해지지 않았다”고 했다.)

The membership subscription fee has also not been determined yet. However, given that major domestic platform companies such as Naver and Coupang charge around 4,900 to 8,000 won per month, the price is likely to be set at a similar level. If benefits differ by membership tier, subscription fees could also be applied differentially. (멤버십 구독료 역시 아직 정해지지 않았다. 다만, 네이버와 쿠팡 등 국내 주요 플랫폼 기업들이 월 4900~8000원 안팎의 구독료를 받고 있는 만큼 비슷한 수준에서 가격이 책정될 가능성이 크다. 멤버십 등급에 따라 제공되는 혜택이 달라질 경우 구독료가 차등 적용될 수도 있다.)

Kakao has so far operated various paid services across its affiliates. KakaoTalk sells the 'Emoticon Plus' product (3,900 won per month) that allows unlimited use of emoticons for a monthly fee, and Kakao Mobility also operates 'Kakao T Membership' (4,900 won per month), which offers discount coupons and point accumulation benefits when using taxis, bikes, parking, and more. Kakao Entertainment provides subscription memberships for each service, such as Melon, Kakao Webtoon, and Kakao Page. (카카오는 그동안 계열사별로 다양한 유료 서비스를 운영해왔다. 카카오톡은 월 구독료를 내고 이모티콘을 무제한 쓸 수 있는 ‘이모티콘 플러스’(월 3900원) 상품을 판매하고 있으며, 카카오모빌리티도 택시·바이크·주차 등을 이용할 때 할인 쿠폰과 포인트 적립 혜택을 받을 수 있는 ‘카카오 T 멤버십’(월 4900원)을 운영하고 있다. 카카오엔터테인먼트의 경우 멜론·카카오웹툰·카카오페이지 등 서비스별로 구독 멤버십을 제공한다.)

In addition, industry sources suggest that financial and commerce affiliates such as Kakao Pay, Kakao Shopping, and Kakao Style (Zigzag) could be included in the membership. In particular, since Kakao recently announced during its second-quarter earnings call that it would connect the food delivery platform 'Coupang Eats' to its AI assistant service 'Kanana in KakaoTalk', there are observations that the company could expand membership benefits through partnerships with external platforms in the future. (업계에선 여기에 더해 카카오페이와 카카오쇼핑, 카카오스타일(지그재그) 등 금융·커머스 계열 서비스가 멤버십에 포함될 가능성도 거론된다. 특히, 카카오는 최근 2분기 실적 발표회에서 자사 AI 비서 서비스인 ‘카나나 인 카카오톡’에 음식 배달 플랫폼 ‘쿠팡이츠’를 연결하겠다고 밝힌 만큼, 향후 외부 플랫폼과의 제휴를 통해 멤버십 혜택을 확대할 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

An industry insider said, "Since the company already has a solid user base through KakaoTalk, which is used by the entire nation, it seems the company is trying to find a new growth model based on this," adding, "Whether Kakao will expand its membership ecosystem centered on its own services like Coupang, or design it mainly around external partnerships like Naver, remains to be seen." (업계 한 관계자는 “전 국민이 사용하는 카카오톡을 통해 이미 탄탄한 이용자 기반을 확보하고 있는 만큼, 이를 바탕으로 회사가 새로운 성장 모델을 찾으려는 것 같다”며 “카카오가 쿠팡처럼 자체 서비스 중심으로 멤버십 생태계를 확장할지, 네이버처럼 외부 파트너십 제휴 위주로 설계할지는 좀 더 지켜봐야 할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

item.title: 'Yellow school bus' era of 25,000 vehicles... Hyundai develops child-safe boarding/alighting and location-sharing solutions (‘노란 학원차’ 2만5천대 시대…현대차, 아동 안심 승하차·위치 공유 솔루션 개발)
item.description:
Across the country, there are 31,091 commuter vehicles operated by educational institutions such as kindergartens, private academies, and elementary/middle/high schools. A total of 8,124 kindergarten vehicles are in operation. Private academy vehicles number as many as 17,344. The School Safety Support System provides information such as basic commuter vehicle details, whether operators and attendants have completed training, and insurance coverage status. The intent is to ease parents' concerns and ensure children's safety, but anxiety inevitably remains. (전국의 유치원과 학원, 초중고 등 교육기관에서 운영하는 통학차량은 3만1091대다. 8124대의 유치원 차량이 운영되고 있다. 학원 차량은 1만7344대에 이른다. 학교안전지원시스템은 통학차량 기본 정보와 운영자·동승자 교육수료 여부, 보험가입 여부 등 정보를 제공한다. 학부모 우려를 해소하고 아이의 안전을 확보하려는 취지인데, 그래도 불안한 것은 어쩔 수 없다.)

Hyundai Motor has decided to develop a 'child-safe boarding and alighting solution exclusively for school commuter vehicles' together with KT, kindergarten operation solution provider Kizno, and specialty vehicle manufacturer MTR. Hyundai announced on the 2nd that it signed a business agreement with these companies to develop a new child commuter vehicle and establish a safety model that links commuter vehicle data with commuting services. (현대차가 KT, 유치원 운영 솔루션업체 키즈노트, 특장차 전문기업 MTR과 함께 ‘어린이 통학차 전용 안심 승하차 솔루션’을 개발하기로 했다. 현대차는 이들 기업과 통학차량 데이터와 통학 서비스를 연계한 새로운 어린이 통학차 개발 및 안전 모델 구축을 위한 업무협약을 맺었다고 2일 밝혔다.)

The new commuter vehicle will be developed based on Hyundai's electric van, the Staria EV. The plan is to develop peace-of-mind services including △detection of children remaining in the vehicle and safety monitoring △real-time location sharing △automatic boarding/alighting confirmation and notifications △automatic driving log recording, and to enhance child commuter safety and operational convenience through pilot operations. (새 통학차 개발은 현대차의 전기 승합차인 스타리아 EV를 기반으로 하게 된다. △차량 내 잔류 아동 감지 및 안전 모니터링 △실시간 위치 공유 △자동 승하차 확인 및 알림 △자동 운행일지 기록 등 안심 서비스를 개발하는 한편, 실증 운영을 거쳐 어린이 통학 안전성과 운영 편의성을 높인다는 계획이다.)

To this end, Hyundai will utilize vehicle data such as speed, ignition status, and GPS to develop the safe boarding and alighting features. MTR, which sells 'Kidion,' a Staria EV-based academy vehicle equipped with child alighting confirmation devices and child-specific seats, will take charge of introducing various safety devices suitable for children. KT will provide the telecommunications infrastructure connecting the vehicle with the safe boarding/alighting service to help more accurately track children's location and movement information. Kizno will operate a service that provides real-time commuting-related information about children to parents and teachers through an application. (이를 위해 현대차는 차량 속도, 시동 여부, GPS 등 차량 데이터를 활용해 안심 승하차 기능을 개발한다. 어린이 하차 확인 장치, 어린이 전용시트 등을 갖춘 스타리아 EV 기반 학원 차량 ‘키디온’을 판매하는 MTR은 아동에게 적합한 각종 안전장치 도입 등을 맡는다. KT는 차량과 안심 승하차 서비스를 연결하는 통신 인프라를 제공해 아동 위치 및 이동 정보를 보다 정확하게 파악할 수 있도록 돕는다. 키즈노트는 애플리케이션을 통해 학부모와 교사에게 아이의 통학 관련 정보를 실시간으로 제공하는 서비스를 운영하게 된다.)

"We view Hyundai's multipurpose vehicles as a key axis that goes beyond simple transportation to connect customers' daily lives and services," said Yeom Jae-seop, executive vice president and head of Hyundai's domestic sales division. "Through this collaboration, we will continue expanding our business as a solution provider that creates a commuting environment where children and guardians can feel at ease and delivers tangible value to customers." (현대차 국내판매사업부장 염재섭 상무는 “현대차의 다목적 차량은 단순한 이동수단을 넘어 고객의 일상과 서비스를 연결하는 핵심축이다. 이번 협력을 통해 어린이와 보호자가 안심할 수 있는 통학 환경을 만들고 고객에게 실질적인 가치를 제공하는 솔루션 프로바이더로서 사업을 지속 확대해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Kim Nam-il Reporter namfic@hani.co.kr (김남일 기자 namfic@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreigners' Card Spending in Korea Hits Record $4.86 Billion in Q2 (외국인, 2분기 국내서 48.6억달러 카드 결제…사상 최고)
item.description:
Card spending in Korea by non-residents, led by foreign tourists, reached a record quarterly high of $4.86 billion in the second quarter. (외국인 관광객을 중심으로 한 비거주자의 카드 국내 사용 금액이 지난 2분기에 48억6천만달러로 분기 기준 사상 최고치를 기록했다.)

According to the "Card Usage Performance for Q2" released by the Bank of Korea on Tuesday, card (credit + debit) usage by non-residents in Korea totaled $4.86 billion, up 36.1% from the previous quarter and far exceeding the previous record of $3.79 billion set in Q2 of last year. The number of cards used by non-residents rose to 25.02 million, up 34.3% from the previous quarter, and the average spending per card increased from $192 in Q1 to $194 in Q2. (한국은행이 2일 내놓은 ‘2분기 중 카드 사용 실적’을 보면, 비거주자의 국내 카드(신용+체크) 사용금액은 48억6천만달러로 전분기에 견줘 36.1% 증가하면서 종전 최고치(지난해 2분기 37억9천만달러)를 크게 웃돌았다. 비거주자의 사용 카드 수는 2502만장으로 전분기보다 34.3% 늘었으며 카드 1장당 사용금액은 1분기 192달러에서 2분기 194달러로 증가했다.)

Jung Hwi-chae, deputy director of the Bank of Korea's capital movements analysis team, attributed the increase in card usage by non-residents to "an increase in foreign tourists entering the country." The number of foreign tourists entering Korea was tallied at 4.76 million in Q1 and 5.97 million in Q2. (한은 자본이동분석팀 정휘채 차장은 비거주자의 카드 국내 사용 증가에 대해 “외국인 관광객의 국내 입국 증가에 따른 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 국내 입국 외국인 관광객은 1분기 476만명, 2분기 597만명에 이른 것으로 집계돼 있다.)

Card spending abroad by residents was tallied at $5.85 billion, down 4.2% from Q1. It was up 5.9% from Q2 of last year. By card type, both credit cards (-0.6% from the previous quarter) and debit cards (-11.5%) declined. Residents' overseas card spending hit an all-time high of $6.11 billion in Q4 of last year, and Q1 of this year's spending ($6.1 billion) was close to that level. (거주자의 카드 해외 사용금액은 58억5천만달러로, 1분기에 견줘 4.2% 줄어든 것으로 집계됐다. 지난해 2분기보다는 5.9% 늘었다. 카드 종류별로는 신용카드(1분기 대비 -0.6%), 체크카드(-11.5%) 모두 감소했다. 거주자의 카드 해외 사용 실적은 지난해 4분기에 61억1천만달러로 역대 최고를 기록했고, 올해 1분기 사용액(61억달러)도 여기에 근접한 수준이었다.)

The Bank of Korea explained the decline in residents' overseas card spending as being "due to a decrease in the number of departing Koreans, which weakened travel-related spending, even though overseas direct purchases through online shopping increased." According to the Korea Culture & Tourism Institute's Tourism Knowledge and Information System, the number of outbound Korean travelers fell 20.4% from 8.331 million in Q1 to 6.631 million in Q2. Data from the national data portal showed that overseas direct purchase amounts through online shopping rose 4.3% from $1.35 billion in Q1 to $1.41 billion in Q2. (한은은 거주자의 카드 해외 사용 감소에 대해 “온라인 쇼핑 해외 직접 구매액이 증가했음에도 내국인 출국자 수가 줄어 여행 관련 지출이 위축됐기 때문”으로 풀이했다. 한국문화관광연구원 관광지식정보시스템에 따르면 내국인 출국자 수는 1분기 833만1천명에서 2분기 663만1천명으로 20.4% 줄었다. 국가데이터처 자료를 보면, 온라인 쇼핑 해외 직접 구매액은 1분기 13억5천만달러에서 2분기 14억1천만달러로 4.3% 증가한 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Preventing 'Grabbing the Neck and Lying Down'... Whiplash Claims Exceeding 8 Weeks of Treatment Will Require Review (‘뒷목 잡고 드러눕기’ 막는다…교통사고 경상 치료 8주 넘길 땐 심사받아야)
item.description:
From now on, patients with minor injuries from traffic accidents who require treatment for more than 8 weeks must pass a separate review. This is a measure to prevent excessive medical treatment in advance. (앞으로 교통사고를 당한 경상 환자가 8주 넘게 치료받으려면 별도 심사를 통과해야 한다. 과잉 진료 문제를 사전에 차단하기 위한 조처다.)

The Financial Supervisory Service announced on the 2nd amendments to the 'Standard Terms and Conditions for Automobile Insurance' containing such content. This reflects criticism that the burden on insurers from unnecessary treatment by some patients is ultimately passed on to all policyholders through premium increases. The revised terms will be applied sequentially starting from the 10th of this month. (금융감독원은 이런 내용을 담은 ‘자동차보험 표준약관’ 개정 사항을 2일 발표했다. 일부 환자의 불필요한 치료로 인한 보험사 부담이 결국 보험료 인상을 통해 보험 가입자 모두에게 전가되고 있다는 지적을 반영한 것이다. 개정 약관은 오는 10일부터 순차적으로 반영된다.)

First, a mechanism has been put in place to curb long-term treatment for minor injury patients. Previously, after submitting a medical certificate, there were no further procedures until treatment concluded, but now, if treatment exceeds 8 weeks, a specialist medical reviewer at the Automobile Damage Compensation Guarantee Agency must assess the necessity of continued treatment. If the specialist reviewer rejects extended treatment, the patient may file an objection. Minor injuries primarily include simple contusions or sprains that are not severe in nature, and infants and pregnant women are excluded. (먼저 경상 환자의 장기 치료에 제동 장치를 마련했다. 이제까지는 진단서를 제출한 뒤 치료가 종결될 때까지 별다른 절차가 없었으나, 앞으로는 치료 기간이 8주를 넘길 경우 자동차손해배상진흥원의 전문의료인이 치료 필요성을 검토해야 한다. 전문의료인이 장기 치료를 기각한 경우 환자는 이의 제기를 할 수 있다. 경상에는 주로 상해 정도가 심각하지 않은 단순 타박상이나 염좌가 포함되며, 영유아와 임산부는 제외된다.)

'Future medical expenses,' which were paid somewhat like settlement amounts, are also being restricted. Previously, insurers customarily paid future medical expenses without contractual basis to expedite claim closures, but there was criticism that these tended to be calculated generously, leading to excessive claim payouts. Accordingly, the FSS revised the terms so that future medical expenses will no longer be paid to minor injury patients, and only actual incurred costs will be covered. For seriously injured patients, the terms now specify that objectively recognized costs necessary for treatment may be paid as future medical expenses. (일종의 합의금처럼 지급되던 ‘향후치료비’에도 제동이 걸린다. 이제까지 보험사는 사고를 빨리 종결하기 위해 약관상 근거가 없는 향후치료비를 관행적으로 지급해왔는데, 이를 넉넉하게 산정하는 경향이 있어 보험금 과잉 지급 문제로 이어진다는 지적이 있었다. 이에 금감원은 앞으로 경상 환자에게는 향후치료비를 지급하지 않고 실제 발생한 비용만 제공하도록 약관을 개정했다. 중상 환자의 경우에는 치료를 위해 필요하다고 객관적으로 인정되는 비용을 향후치료비로 지급할 수 있다고 명시했다.)

item.title: Top 500 Companies' 'First-Half Salaries' Average 55 Million Won...Securities Firms Top 100 Million Won Amid Stock Market Boom (500대 기업 ‘상반기 급여’ 평균 5500만원…증시 호황에 증권사는 1억원 넘어)
item.description:
In the first half of this year, the average six-month salary received by employees at major domestic large corporations reached 55 million won per person. In the case of securities firms, with the domestic stock market boom that began in earnest last year adding hefty performance bonuses, many companies saw their average six-month salary per employee exceed 100 million won. (올해 상반기 국내 주요 대기업 직원들이 받은 6개월치 급여가 1명당 평균 5500만원에 이르는 것으로 나타났다. 증권사의 경우, 지난해부터 본격화한 국내 증시 호황에 따른 거액의 성과급 등이 더해지면서 직원 1명당 6개월치 급여 평균이 1억원을 넘어선 곳이 많았다.)

According to an analysis by CEO Score, a corporate data research institute, on the 2nd, of the top 500 domestic companies by sales last year, 345 companies for which changes in employee salaries could be identified had an average salary per employee of 54.99 million won in the first half of this year (January to June). This is a 7.1% (3.63 million won) increase compared to the first half of last year. (2일 기업데이터연구소인 시이오(CEO)스코어가 지난해 국내 매출액 상위 500개 기업 중 직원 급여의 변동 현황을 파악할 수 있는 345개사를 분석한 결과, 이들 기업의 올해 상반기(1~6개월) 직원 1명당 평균 급여는 5499만원으로 집계됐다. 이는 지난해 상반기에 견줘 7.1%(363만원) 늘어난 금액이다.)

Simply converting this to an annual salary, the average annual pay received by employees at major domestic large corporations exceeds 100 million won. However, since first-half salaries typically include performance bonuses paid at the beginning of the year based on the previous year's performance, there may be a difference from the actual annual salary level. (이를 연간 급여로 단순 환산하면 국내 주요 대기업 직원들이 받는 평균 연봉이 1억원을 넘어서는 것이다. 다만, 통상 상반기 급여에는 기업들이 전년 실적을 토대로 연초에 지급하는 성과급이 포함된다는 점에서 실제 연간 급여 수준과는 차이가 있을 수 있다.)

By average salary range for the first half, the 40 million to 60 million won bracket was the most common at 43.5% (150 companies). This was followed by 20 million to 40 million won (24.9%), 60 million to 80 million won (18.6%), and 80 million to 100 million won (6.7%). (상반기 평균 급여액 구간별로는 4천만~6천만원이 43.5%(150개사)로 가장 많았다. 이어 2천만~4천만원(24.9%), 6천만~8천만원(18.6%), 8천만~1억원(6.7%) 순이었다.)

There were also as many as 20 companies where the average six-month salary paid to employees in the first half of this year exceeded 100 million won. Korea Financial Group had the highest average salary per employee at 184 million won. It was followed by Meritz Securities (165.21 million won), Korea Investment & Securities (162 million won), Yuanta Securities (149 million won), SK Hynix (144 million won), Dunamu (139.75 million won), Mirae Asset Securities (136 million won), Meritz Financial Group (130 million won), Hana Securities (124 million won), and NH Investment & Securities (123 million won). (올해 상반기에 직원들에게 지급한 6개월치 평균 급여가 1억원을 넘는 기업도 20개나 됐다. 한국금융지주의 직원 1명당 평균급여가 1억8400만원으로 가장 많았다. 메리츠증권(1억6521만원), 한국투자증권(1억6200만원), 유안타증권(1억4900만원), 에스케이(SK)하이닉스(1억4400만원), 두나무(1억3975만원), 미래에셋증권(1억3600만원), 메리츠금융지주(1억3천만원), 하나증권(1억2400만원), 엔에이치(NH)투자증권(1억2300만원) 등이 뒤를 이었다.)

In particular, 60% (12 companies) of the companies whose 'average six-month salary exceeded 100 million won' were securities firms. This means that more than 10 of the 50 licensed domestic securities firms paid their employees salaries in the 'hundred-million-won' range. (특히 ‘6개월치 평균 급여 1억원’ 초과 기업의 60%(12개사)가 증권사였다. 국내 제도권 증권사 50개 중 10개 이상이 ‘억’ 소리 나는 보수를 직원들에게 지급했다는 얘기다.)

Kim Seong-chun, a lead researcher at CEO Score, noted, "The KOSPI (Korea Composite Stock Price Index) has continued to rise since the second half of last year, and trading volume has also surged significantly." Thanks to the exceptional strength of the domestic stock market, securities firms saw their profits swell, leading to a lavish distribution of performance bonuses. Indeed, the average first-half salary per employee at firms such as Yuanta, Hana, Mirae Asset, and Meritz Securities surged by tens of millions of won compared to the same period last year. (김성춘 시이오스코어 책임연구원은 “지난해 하반기부터 코스피(유가증권시장) 지수가 계속 상승하고 주식 거래량도 대폭 늘어난 영향이 크다”고 짚었다. 이례적인 국내 증시의 초강세 덕에 증권사 이익이 불어나며 성과급 잔치를 벌인 셈이다. 실제 유안타·하나·미래에셋·메리츠증권 등의 올해 상반기 직원 1명당 평균 급여는 전년 동기 대비 수천만원이 급증했다.)

On the other hand, E-Land World (17 million won), CJ Freshway (19 million won), Hyundai Green Food (20.32 million won), L&F (23 million won), Hanwha Hotels & Resorts (23 million won), Daou Data (26 million won), Ottogi (26 million won), and Emart (26 million won) were found to have notably low average first-half salaries per employee this year. This is attributed to their high proportion of short-time workers such as interns and part-timers, or the relatively large number of low-wage jobs in food service, catering, and retail sectors. (반면 이랜드월드(1700만원), 씨제이(CJ)프레시웨이(1900만원), 현대그린푸드(2032만원), 엘앤에프(2300만원), 한화호텔앤드리조트(2300만원), 다우데이타(2600만원), 오뚜기(2600만원), 이마트(2600만원) 등은 직원 1명당 올해 상반기 평균 급여가 두드러지게 낮은 것으로 조사됐다. 인턴·아르바이트 등 단시간 노동자 비중이 높거나, 급식·음식·유통 등 저임금 일자리가 상대적으로 많기 때문으로 풀이된다.)
